original.name: Coinbase Bridge (cbBTC and other wrapped assets)
original.rank_basis: #3 in 'Bridge' by TVL: $6,150.9m, wrapping assets from Bitcoin, XRP, Doge, Cardano and Litecoin (api.llama.fi/protocols, 2026-08-04). DefiLlama description: 'Wrapped tokens backed 1:1 by assets held by Coinbase.'
residue: Identical residue to WBTC: no element for off-chain custody, no element for legal recourse against the custodian, no element for the difference between an exchange-operated wrap and a consortium-operated one.
No element for 'the custodian is also the largest venue where the wrapped asset trades' — a concentration property with real depeg implications.

No element for the fact that this bridges five non-smart-contract source chains (Bitcoin, XRP, Doge, Cardano, Litecoin) where no verification mechanism is even possible. The vocabulary implicitly assumes both domains can run code.

forced.why: only approximately applies — redemption runs through a Coinbase account subject to KYC and terms of service, not through a contract. Same overstatement as WBTC.
CANDIDATE-REGISTER. The issuer can freeze and can decline to redeem.
only approximately applies — reserve reporting is periodic and issuer-published, not a protocol mechanism.
